we have developed and implemented an information pile metaphor for PDA's that takes advantage of human memory and spatial capabilities, and we have developed an extension that allows users to transfer piles to and from tabletop displays.
We describe a new way to organize information on small screen devices that takes advantage of spatial memory capabilities and obviates the use of complex folder trees.

1) we have developed a system that allows users to place information items onto virtual piles that extend beyond the display of a small-screen device, 2) we have developed an extension to this system that allows users in the same room to share and manipulate information piles, and 3) we have developed extensions to our system that allows users of small-screen devices to manipulate piles that are projected onto a large shared display.

the design of a system to support the organization and sharing of information in a mobile computing environment.
how people can use small-screen devices to organize and share information in a natural way.
how small-screen device users can organize information in ways that are consistent with human spatial memory capabilities, and how they can share and organize information with others.
